introduction: This has reference to your application and subsequent interviews you have had with Craft Interactive Technologies Pvt Ltd, we are pleased to appoint you as {{ doc.designation or "Designation" }} under Level {{ doc.level or "Level" }} at our Calicut office. We are confident that your experience and expertise will add significant value to the organization. Your employment will be governed by the terms and conditions set forth below:
name: Direct Appointment

terms.description: You will be paid a monthly gross salary of Rs. {{ "%.2f"|format(doc.gross_salary) if doc.gross_salary else "" }} per month as fixed package. Standard deductions of PF, ESI/Insurance, Labour Welfare Fund, Professional Tax and TDS are applicable as per the Income Tax Act. The salary structure is detailed in Annexure-1 You will be entitled to receive gratuity in accordance with the rules governing payment of gratuity, at the time of separation or retirement. Your salary is strictly confidential, and we expect that you maintain the confidentiality of the same
terms.title: Remuneration & Benefit

terms.description:
As per the current policy, Company operates in a single shift from 9.30 AM to 6.30 PM, Monday to Friday (five-day work week). However, based on business exigencies, some flexibility in working hours may be required from time to time.

Your specific working hours and weekly off, if any changes are necessary, will be communicated accordingly.

You are required to regularly sign the attendance register and log your attendance through company's biometric system as part of official attendance process.
terms.title: Working Hours

terms.description: Your date of appointment as per company records is {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.appointment_date) if doc.appointment_date else "Date" }}.
terms.title: Date of Appointment

terms.description:
Your performance will be reviewed periodically as per the policy of the Company.

It is agreed that it shall be open to the company from time to time to vary any remuneration, benefit, facility or perquisite that may be extended to you as per the company's decision on the basis of demonstrated results and effectiveness of performance during the period of review.

Increments are not automatic but will be based solely on efficient, satisfactory and loyal discharge of duties as assessed by our performance appraisal system.
terms.title: Performance Review

terms.description: You will be on probation for a period of six months from the date of your appointment. Confirmation and permanent placement with Craft is contingent upon your successful completion of the probation. If not confirmed after six months, this order will continue to be in operation, and the probation period will stand extended automatically till further notice.
terms.title: Probation Period

terms.description: You will be governed by the applicable Leave & Holiday Policy of the company which is subjected to revision from time to time at the discretion of the management.
terms.title: Leave & Holiday

terms.description: Whenever you are required to undertake travel on Company work, you will be reimbursed travel expenses as per Company rules.
terms.title: Travel

terms.description:
Your designation is merely indicative of responsibilities, which you are required to carry out. The company shall be entitled to require you, at any time, to perform any other administrative, managerial, supervisory, or other functions and you will be bound to carry out such functions.

In view of your office, you must effectively perform to ensure results. Your performance would be reviewed as per the Company's Performance Management System.

You shall maintain proper discipline and dignity of your office and shall deal with all matters with sobriety. The key responsibilities are outlined in Annexure-2
terms.title: Responsibilities

terms.description: The age for retirement from service in the company is 58 or as decided by the management whichever is later.
terms.title: Retirement Age

terms.description:
While on probation, this appointment may be terminated by either side by giving seven days written notice, or seven days salary in lieu of notice period, at the discretion of the management.

Upon confirmation of your employment, this appointment may be terminated by either side by giving three months' written notice.

You will adhere to the Code of Conduct guidelines of the company. If you commit any breach of the Code of Conduct and polices, or your conduct is detrimental to the interests of the company, your service will be terminated without any notice or payment in lieu thereof.

You may be terminated from your employment if identified with communicable disease/ailment, to not to endanger other employees, at the discretion of the management.
terms.title: Notice Period

terms.description: You will be liable to be transferred to any other department or establishment or branch or subsidiary of the Company in India or abroad. In such a case, you will be governed by the terms and conditions of service as applicable to the new assignment.
terms.title: Transfer

terms.description: Your position with the Company calls for whole time employment and you will devote yourself exclusively to the business of the Company. You will not take up any other work for remuneration (part time or otherwise) or work on advisory capacity or be interested directly or indirectly (except as shareholder or debenture holder) in any other trade or business during your employment with the Company, without written permission from the Company.
terms.title: Other work

terms.description:
You will not seek full time or part time job or be involved in any way with competitor's business activities either directly or indirectly during your employment with the Company, and for a period of twelve months in the event of cessation of your employment with the Company.

You shall not for a period of twelve months after the cessation of your employment canvass, solicit or approach or cause to be canvassed, solicited or approached, any client or customer of the company, its subsidiaries or associated companies about whom you have gained knowledge as a result of your employment with the company during the course of your employment with the company.
terms.title: Conflict of Interest

terms.description:
You will not, at any time, without the consent of the Company disclose or divulge or make public except under legal obligation, any information regarding Company's affairs, whether the same may be confided to you or become known to you, in the course of your service or otherwise.

If during the period of your employment with us you achieve any invention, process improvement, operational improvement or other process/methods, likely to result in more efficient operation of any of the activities of the company, the company shall be entitled to use, utilize and exploit such improvements and you shall assign all your rights to the company for the purpose of seeking any patent right in respect thereof or for any other purpose.
terms.title: Confidential Information

terms.description:
On termination of this contract, you will immediately give up to the Company all correspondence, specifications, manuals, books, documents, market data, cost data, literature, drawings, effect or records, etc. belonging to the Company or relating to its business and shall not make or retain any copies of these items.

For the purpose of determining your terminal benefits your length of service with the company will commence from the date on which you join the company.
terms.title: On termination

terms.description:
Notices may be given by you to the Company at its head office address in Calicut. Notices may be given by the Company to you at the address intimated by you in the official records.

You will forthwith inform the company of any change in your residential/communication address.
terms.title: Notices

terms.description:
The above terms and conditions are based on Company Policy, Procedures and other Rules and Regulations currently applicable to the Company's employees are subject to amendments and adjustments from time to time.

Please communicate your acceptance of this appointment by signing a copy of this letter and returning it to us.

We welcome you to the Craft family and trust we will have a long and mutually rewarding association.
terms.title: General
